game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Underground River Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before cave spiders overload Underground River.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before cave spiders overload Underground River. Each round, a new arrows challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 100 points of arrows by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
